units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 5:4">Targ. Lam. V, 4</cite> (h. text <cite ref="M00879"><he>מְחִיר</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 5b:20">B. Mets. 5ᵇ</cite> he thinks (as a mental reservation) <he>דמי קא יהבנא ליה</he> I am willing to compensate him.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 5b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>לא תחמוד לאינשי בלא ד׳ משמע להו</he> common people understand the law, ‘thou shalt not covet’ (<cite ref="Exodus 20:16">Ex. XX, 16</cite>) to mean coveting to get our neighbor’s property without compensation.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 46a:13">B. Kam. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>אי דְּמֵי רדיא וכ׳</he> if he paid the market price of a ploughing ox, he surely bought him for ploughing; a. fr.
